clusters.pick_reason: Both patch the identical check in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts. #1996 introduces a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that parses the Accept header into media-range/parameter tokens and explicitly honors the q=0 'not acceptable' quality parameter. #2046's replacement uses a plain substring check (acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')), which does not account for q=0 exclusions and is more prone to false-positive substring matches on unrelated media types in a compound Accept header. #1996's approach handles more of the real-world Accept header variations correctly.
